description: This file contains unit tests for socket connection and idle state detection in the Starboard platform, using Google Test framework. It tests various socket states such as invalid, connected, listening, and non-connected scenarios, including IPv4 and IPv6 support.

classes.name: SbSocketIsConnectedAndIdleTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing socket connection and idle state with different address types.

classes.name: PairSbSocketIsConnectedAndIdleTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing socket pairs with different address type combinations.

methods.name: GetAddressType
methods.description: Returns the socket address type parameter for the test.

methods.name: GetServerAddressType
methods.description: Returns the server address type parameter for the socket pair test.

methods.name: GetClientAddressType
methods.description: Returns the client address type parameter for the socket pair test.
